content.title: eBay down? Thousands of users say ‘search not working’ amid reported outage | Hindustan Times
content.text: Thousands report eBay search outages Monday, with 4,000+ users flagging issues on Down Detector affecting app and website functionality. Thousands of users of the shopping platform eBay are reporting that the search function on their eBay app and website is not working Monday. More than 4,000 users have reported facing problems with eBay on Down Detector, a website that tracks outages based on users' reports.Representational. (Unsplash)As of 1:07pm EST, more than 4336 people have reported facing problems with eBay on Down Detector. 59% of the users said that the search function was not working, while 23% said they encountered issues with the app, while 17% complained that the website malfunctioned.More than 4,336 users reported issues with eBay, as of 1:07pm ET.
